text.p: These are the leading stories in the Sarajevo press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The European Union on Monday delivered vehicles and equipment worth 4.6 million German marks to the Moslem-Croat Federation's largest water companies, the organisation said in a statement.
- Bosnia and the UK reached a bilateral agreement on economic cooperation during the London summit on Bosnia last week, the British embassy in Sarajevo said.

- There are no secret deals between the Organization for Security and Cooperation in Europe (OSCE) and the Bosnian Serb republic which signed an agreement on local elections, said the Bosnian member of the OSCE's Provisional Election Commission.
- Sarajevo airport will probably be open to all civilian flights, including commercial traffic, from January, said Ismet Secic, Bosnia's manager for civil aviation.

- World Bank signs agreement with Bosnian Health Ministry to provide medical equipment worth some 2.3 million German marks for the rehabilitation of war casuqalties. --Sarajevo newsroom, +387-71-663-864
